title: cohorts.registry.json — global cohort registry per SPEC_cohorts_v1
description: One row per cohort + one row per cross_reference_handoff. Atlas-core's cross_atlas_imports.js consults this at every cross-atlas read. See atlas-core/docs/SPEC_cohorts_v1.md for the full specification, design rationale, and migration plan.

version.description: Semver of the registry shape itself, NOT of any individual cohort.

cohorts.description: Every cohort that exists in any atlas (and reserved cohort_ids for future work).

cohort_id.description: Stable slug. Unique across the registry.

label.description: Human-readable cohort name surfaced in UIs / error messages.

species.description: List of binomial species names. F1 hybrid cohorts list both parents.

n_samples_approx.description: Approximate sample count; null when not yet enumerated.

atlases.description: atlas_ids (from atlases/_index.json) that use this cohort. Empty for reserved cohort_ids.

cross_reference_handoffs.description: Every legitimate cross-cohort coordinate flow. cross_atlas_imports.js denies cross-cohort reads UNLESS they match a handoff entry.

via_layer_pattern.description: Regex matched against `<atlas_id>.<layer_id>`. Single source of truth for which producer layers this handoff covers.

handoff_kind.description: What's being passed across the cohort boundary. 'coordinate_handoff' = bp positions / interval coords only (BP_ATLAS pattern). 'reference_join' = both sides share a reference assembly. 'none_yet' = reserved for future handoffs.

rationale.description: Why this read is safe. Required, audited at review. The text is shown verbatim in CohortMismatchError messages.
